notes: Line 1, the Pearl Street Trunk, opened in November 1905 (first revenue service); the tracker names no stations for it.

Lines 1-7 between their original termini are Phase 1, years not set; only Line 3's termini (St Bernard to Baltimore) are known. Line 1's first segment (the Pearl Street Trunk, November 1905) stays not set (Ben).

metro|Scholl.note: Goebel to early 1942; Commonwealth early 1942 to 1946 (renamed after the US entered the war, for the likeness to Goebbels); Scholl from 1946, after Hans and Sophie Scholl of the White Rose, when Cincinnati, and with it Covington, became Munich's sister city (as Munich's Geschwister-Scholl-Platz). Goebel Park keeps its name (Ben, 28 October).

about: Opening year and phase of every Metro and TRI segment and station (Ben, 28 October). Phases by year: tracker 2B, with the years between as Ben ruled (1919-33 Phase 1, 1942-49 Phase 2, 1980 on later).
